crossRefs.note: Now I have heard that you have shearers. Your shepherds have now been with us, and we didn’t harm them. Nothing was…
Now David had said, “Surely in vain I have kept all that this fellow has in the wilderness, so that nothing was missed…
that you may become blameless and harmless, children of God without defect in the middle of a crooked and perverse…

translations.web: But the men were very good to us, and we were not harmed, and we didn’t miss anything, as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields.
translations.bsb: Yet these men were very good to us. When we were in the field, we were not harassed, and nothing of ours went missing the whole time we lived among them.
translations.kjv: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we any thing, as long as we were conversant with them, when we were in the fields:
translations.asv: But the men were very good unto us, and we were not hurt, neither missed we anything, as long as we went with them, when we were in the fields:
